title: Brief traceability register
rule: A status is set only by repository evidence or an official source. 'done' means a file in this repository implements the item. 'partial' means it is implemented with a stated gap. 'missing' means a search of the repository found no implementation. 'blocked' means a source needed to build it does not exist or cannot be reached from this environment.

status_key.done: Implemented and evidenced in this repository.
status_key.partial: Implemented in part; the gap is stated.
status_key.missing: Not found in the repository by search.
status_key.blocked: Cannot be built: the source it needs is not available.

rows.requirement: Scheduled job refreshes the official schedule, standings, team stats and injury report for each rolling slate, and rebuilds only after freshness and provenance gates pass.
rows.evidence: Workflow runs 3x daily (cron 11:15, 15:15, 22:15 UTC). engine/fetch_official.py captures sources; engine/refresh_gate.py fails closed on freshness, provenance and promotion; scripts/test_refresh_gate.py tests the gate. Latest scheduled run: success.
rows.gap: Structured parsing of stats and schedule and automated consecutive-report status diffs are still open (see §38 RFG4 'needs review').

The three rows completed under COORDINATION §50 (Q01) are HOU@WAS 147-119 (game 0022600242), ATL@MIL 113-106 (0022600243) and OKC@SAC 125-103 (0022600244). rows.evidence: Transcriptions with revision_time_et and retrieved_utc: data/official/injury_2026-11-14_0130PM.json and injury_2026-11-15_0615AM.json. rows.requirement: Freeze a pre-registration file per strategy before its first bet: signal, thresholds, universe, exact settlement rule.
rows.evidence: data/prereg/ holds S01–S08, T-SINGLE, T-PARLAY, T-SGP and an index. Each file has signal, thresholds, universe, exact_settlement_rule, frozen_at_utc, first_tip_of_universe and frozen_before_first_tip = true. Updated 2026-11-16 by session arena/161f1638-nba1. freeze_prereg.py is now rolling and idempotent: the window, the first tip (2026-11-17T00:00Z, converted from the official 7:00 PM ET tip) and every input digest are resolved at run time, and it refuses to publish after the first tip. The 11/16-11/18 set was frozen at 2026-11-16T00:14Z - 23.8 hours before the first tip - as ledger entry 5, which also records data/archive/prereg_2026-11-16/ so a later re-freeze cannot invalidate it.
rows.gap: The earlier 11/15 vintage was indeed frozen after its picks were published; that is recorded in F78 and is not repaired retroactively, because the ledger is append-only.

rows.requirement: Tamper-evident ledger: hash each published pick, publish the hash before tip, verify after settlement.
rows.evidence: data/ledger/ledger.json is a SHA-256 hash chain and now holds SEVEN entries: 1 pre-tip publication (11/14), 2-3 settlement verification and record (11/14), 4 rolling pre-tip freeze (11/15), 5 rolling pre-tip freeze (11/16-18 vintage), 6 settlement verification (11/15) and 7 settlement record (11/15). scripts/verify_ledger.py reports 'ledger chain OK' after each append; the last run verified every entry including the superseded-path checks. 2026-11-16 by session arena/23b323a3-nba1 (COORDINATION §50)
rows.gap: The anchor commit ef2e723 is not an ancestor of origin/main, which is a single squashed root (cd8fd27); it is reachable only through branch history. See flag F79. This is a provenance caveat about the first entry, not a broken chain: entries 4-7 are appended to a head that verifies.

rows.requirement: Split the site into a 'projection' surface (safe to publish now) and a 'bet' surface (gated), and never mix them.
rows.evidence: Two separate surfaces are built by scripts/build_surfaces.py. site/pages/projection.html holds model output only, with 25 rows, each linked to its official game page. It is machine-checked for betting vocabulary, pick markup, and distances. site/pages/bet.html shows four computed gates (G1 validation, G2 sample floor, G3 pre-registration, G4 ledger integrity; data/derived/surface_gates.json). G1 and G2 are closed, so bet.html shows no picks.
rows.gap: site/pages/roll.html still puts singles, two-leg parlays and same-game lines on one page. That page is built by scripts/build_roll_page.py, which another session owns, so the split there is not done. Index links to the two new surfaces are a shared-chrome change for the integration session.

rows.requirement: Keep two independent estimators and publish their disagreement as the primary confidence signal, not a single blended rating.
rows.evidence: The picks table shows 'Ref home margin' beside 'Model home margin' and 'Spread edge'. No second independent estimator module was found by search, and no disagreement headline was found. Updated 2026-11-16 by session arena/161f1638-nba1. Estimator A (scripts/originate_horizon.py) and estimator B (engine/pipeline.py) both produce a line for the same games from the same official inputs. site/pages/roll.html publishes their disagreement as the headline column: on the 13 games both cover, mean |difference| 4.69 points, largest 12.6, and 1 game where they disagree about the favourite.
rows.gap: Build a second, independent estimator and publish the disagreement as the headline. See flag F87.

rows.requirement: Pin home-court advantage to the measured home-win rate instead of fitting it freely.
rows.evidence: engine/model_core.py uses a fixed flat_hca = 2.0. scripts/originate_horizon.py records that HCA 'could not be sourced from an official NBA page'. The 57.6% measured home-win rate from another build is a note only, not applied. Updated 2026-11-16 by session arena/161f1638-nba1. The home-win rate is now measured from official finals: 0.5455 (36 of 66), published on site/pages/roll.html section 5 alongside the measured correlations. The size of the unpinned term is also quantified there: estimator B fits HCA at +3.508 points (t = 1.539, in-sample), estimator A applies none, and that term is 90% of their mean 3.89-point disagreement.
rows.gap: Measured but not applied: no line on the site yet uses the measured home-win rate. See F84.

rows.requirement: Report luck as a z-score per team; refuse to publish a strategy that leans on a team outside the noise band.
rows.evidence: command-center/data/luck.json computes luck_z for all 30 teams from Pythagorean expectation (exponent 13.91) on official OffRtg and DefRtg. The Luck page is built from it.
rows.gap: No noise-band refusal rule was found in code or pages, so strategies are not gated on it. See flag F88.

rows.requirement: Compute rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 from the official schedule, and add travel distance from a sourced arena-coordinate table.
rows.evidence: Rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 are computed from the official schedule (existing evidence, unchanged). Travel distance is not published: Q04 found no official arena-coordinate table. Arena venue names come from nba.com/schedule, and the coordinates come from Wikipedia (secondary) in data/official/arena_coordinates_2026-11-15.json. Those coordinates are not used for distances.
rows.gap: Travel distance is still not computed. A conflict was found: data/derived/horizon_lines_v2.json already holds a travel distance (for example ORL to BOS 2,094 mi) and a travel adjustment (for example 2.513 for ORL), both computed from the Wikipedia-sourced coordinates. The projection margins and totals include that adjustment. Flagged as F109 for review. See also F85.
rows.evidence: Rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 are computed from the official schedule and published per game. Travel distance is computed from data/official/arena_coordinates_2026-11-15.json, whose venue names are transcribed per row from https://www.nba.com/schedule; scripts/travel_distance.py was repointed to that table this session after the table it had been reading (data/arenas.json) was measured to place the LA Clippers at Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles when the official schedule places them at Intuit Dome, Inglewood, CA. 2026-11-16 by session arena/23b323a3-nba1 (COORDINATION §50)
rows.gap: Arena COORDINATES are sourced from the Wikipedia coordinate parameter, not from an NBA-published table (F109), so travel miles are a sourced approximation. data/arenas.json is left on disk and flagged F108 rather than deleted.

rows.requirement: Model minutes redistribution explicitly: for each team, the top-8 minutes shares and the replacement shares when a player is out.
rows.evidence: data/derived/minutes_shares.json measures top-8 minutes shares for 12 team-games across the six 11/15 gamebooks in scope (CHALAC, DALBOS, INDPHI, LALPHX, NYKTOR, SASUTA). Each share is a player's printed minutes divided by the printed team total. Each row links its official nba.com game page and statsdmz gamebook PDF. The page is site/pages/minutes.html. Four team rows whose player minutes differ from the printed total by 1 to 3 seconds are flagged (F108). The overtime game total (NYK@TOR) is 265:00, as printed.
rows.gap: Replacement shares when a player is out are blocked. Measuring them needs the same team's games with and without that player, and the repository has one game per team (n = 1). The three other 11/15 gamebooks (HOUWAS, ATLMIL, OKCSAC) are not in scope for this measure. Per-player minutes beyond the top-50 leaderboard are not covered. See F89.

rows.requirement: Stop publishing a single blended rating as the headline; publish the disagreement as the headline and the blend underneath.
rows.evidence: Not found. The site headline was not verified to be a disagreement measure. Updated 2026-11-16 by session arena/161f1638-nba1. site/pages/roll.html leads with the disagreement column (mean |delta| 4.69 pts) and prints both spreads underneath it; the two are NOT blended, because averaging two models whose errors have not been measured against each other would hide the signal.
rows.gap: Only the new rolling-slate page is built this way. The legacy Lines & Picks surface still leads with a single model's line and carries the disagreement only as flag F26.

rows.requirement: Price every parlay with the measured rho and print the naive product beside it instead of withholding the price.
rows.evidence: scripts/generate_picks.py prices SGPs with rho constants SGP_RHO_TEAMMATES = -0.2 and SGP_RHO_OPPONENTS = 0.05, labelled as model-derived. The correlations page holds rho values. Updated 2026-11-16 by session arena/161f1638-nba1. A rho is now measured from official finals rather than assumed: rho(home margin, game total) = -0.0635 on 66 finals (p = 0.61; -0.0621 on the 63 regulation games), computed by scripts/measure_rho.py. site/pages/roll.html section 4 prices same-game side-and-total at that rho with the naive product printed beside it, and section 3 prints the naive product for cross-game parlays with the exact Frechet-Hoeffding band, because no rho between two different games is measurable from official data and none is asserted.
rows.gap: The SGP rho used by scripts/generate_picks.py is still the fixed model constant described in F90; only the roll page prices from the measured value.

rows.requirement: Put rotation availability on the picks page as its own column.
rows.evidence: The picks table headers are Home injury status and Away injury status. No rotation-availability column exists. Updated 2026-11-16 by session arena/161f1638-nba1. site/pages/roll.html carries a rotation-availability column built from the official injury report: Out / Questionable counts per game plus the count of club blocks still filed as NOT YET SUBMITTED.
rows.gap: The legacy Lines & Picks page still has no such column. See F83.

rows.requirement: Add a market-anchored prior: blend the model line with the closing line, weighted by measured out-of-sample log-loss.
rows.evidence: The blending rule and the measured weight now exist: `scripts/market_anchor.py` (v3) fits w on 60 out-of-sample games in docs/data/backtest.json, each carrying both estimators' pre-tip probability (p_home_model) and a reference probability (p_home_ref), by two independent proper rules with a 2,000-rep bootstrap (seed 20261116). Result: w_logloss = 0.6449 with a 95% CI of [0.0000, 1.0000], w_brier = 0.6330, log-loss 0.58730 pure model vs 0.58058 at w*, improvement 0.00672, one-sided p = 0.313, so the improvement is not significant and the published weight is 0. The output is data/derived/market_anchor.json.
rows.gap: Weighting is implemented and measured, but anchoring has not earned its weight: the confidence interval on w spans the whole range, so today's published blend is 100% model. The market half of the requirement stays BLOCKED on a sourced closing line: `--market` exits 5 without data/external/closing_lines.json, and the required schema is written into market_anchor.json. See F98.

rows.requirement: Model the total as possessions times points per possession, not as an average of team scoring averages.
rows.evidence: scripts/originate_horizon.py: possessions = pace_home + pace_away − league_pace; points = (off_rtg × opp def_rtg ÷ league_off) × possessions ÷ 100; total = home points + away points. Inputs are the official team advanced stats.
rows.gap: None in the formula. Inputs are refreshed by R01.

rows.requirement: Capture per-player game logs (minutes, points, rebounds, assists, opponent) for at least the players on an injury report.
rows.evidence: Per-player logs are captured for all six finished 11/15 games from the league's own gamebook PDFs (text committed verbatim under data/official/gamebooks/, one file per game): 143 player rows, 132 of whom appeared, with MIN, PTS, REB, AST, STL, BLK, TOV, shooting splits, +/- and the DNP/DND note, plus the opponent and home/away. `scripts/capture_player_logs.py` parses them and asserts every team's player points against the official final score - 12 of 12 match - before writing data/official/player_game_logs_2026-11-15.json. The page is site/pages/player-logs.html.
rows.gap: Coverage is complete for the six games that finished and incomplete for the slate: 10 of the 149 players on the 06:15 PM ET injury report appear in these six gamebooks, because 139 of them play for teams whose 11/15 games were unfinished or whose next game is 11/16. A DNP player from a finished game is captured (played=false); a player from an unplayed game cannot be until his gamebook exists. See F99.
